pg_track.title: The lane markings
pg_track.speaker: protagonist
pg_track.text: Several white lane lines cross the open ground. One has been painted over at the bend; the old curve is still visible.
pg_track.repeat_text: The old curve and the newer line remain side by side.

record.text: An old lane curve shows through a newer line.

pg_hoop.title: The practice ring
pg_hoop.speaker: protagonist
pg_hoop.text: A metal ring stands at one edge of the ground. Its net is gone, and the pole has been painted more than once.
pg_hoop.repeat_text: A ring, an empty rim, layers of paint.

record.text: An old practice ring stands without a net.
